title: CF-specific metabolic therapy beyond insulin
one_liner: Adult CFRD is common and the reviewed industry drug map is empty.
what_would_have_to_be_true: CFRD remains prevalent on HEMT; generic SGLT2/GLP-1/metformin are insufficient or poorly tolerated in CF; a CF-specific mechanism or formulation has a feasible endpoint (CGM time-in-range or pulmonary co-benefit).
kill_criteria: Kill if academic SGLT2/GLP-1 studies show off-the-shelf drugs close the gap or if HEMT cohorts show CFRD incidence collapsing toward background.

title: CFTR-independent airway anion transport
one_liner: Nucleic-acid restoration is crowded; a bypass mechanism is the differentiated N1 bet.
what_would_have_to_be_true: ABCI-class ionophores restore airway anion transport without CFTR protein; safety and chronic dosing work in people with CF including nonsense/rare genotypes; nucleic-acid programs do not fully cover the ineligible group first.
kill_criteria: Kill if ABCI safety/tolerability fails or if a mutation-agnostic mRNA/gene therapy demonstrates clinically meaningful restoration in ineligible genotypes.

title: Persistent PA or NTM beyond inhaled-antibiotic SoC
one_liner: Approved inhaled antibiotics remain SoC; novel CF infection programs are thin after review.
what_would_have_to_be_true: Chronic PA or NTM still drives residual lung disease on HEMT; phage or another modality can be manufactured and regulated; culture-ascertainment decline is not the whole PA story.
kill_criteria: Kill if BX004 or similar phage succeeds as a broad incumbent or if PA/NTM prevalence and inhaled-antibiotic use keep collapsing without a new product.

title: Residual airway inflammation on HEMT
one_liner: CF-specific industry anti-inflammatories are absent; NCFB DPP1 programs are the adjacent crowding risk.
what_would_have_to_be_true: Residual PEx and FEV1 impairment on HEMT are inflammatory enough to treat; a CF-specific mechanism or CF trial is required because NCFB drugs do not automatically translate.
kill_criteria: Kill if brensocatib-class DPP1 works in CF or if residual disease is mostly structural damage and infection rather than treatable inflammation.

title: Disease-modifying CF liver disease
one_liner: PERT is a solved product class; advanced CFLD is small severe and untreated by a disease-modifying drug.
what_would_have_to_be_true: Cirrhosis/portal-hypertension endpoints can be studied; the 861-person cirrhosis group is large enough for a development path; UDCA-negative guidance leaves a real gap.
kill_criteria: Kill if the addressable advanced-CFLD population is too small for a trial or if a feasible endpoint cannot be defined.

title: Adult-era treatment-burden and care-delivery services
one_liner: Do not force a drug score onto a services problem. Clinic visits and inhaled-therapy burden remain after modulators.
what_would_have_to_be_true: A services or digital product can reduce visit burden inhaled-therapy time or adult-care coordination with a measurable CF-clinic workflow; reimbursement is plausible without inventing a TAM from 33989 people.
kill_criteria: Kill if the only residual is clinic operations that health systems will absorb or if Registry time-use evidence never materializes.

title: Mutation-agnostic nucleic-acid CFTR restoration
one_liner: This remains the causal remaining restoration problem and it is the crowded investigational column.
what_would_have_to_be_true: A new delivery or editing approach is differentiated from 4D-710 VX-522 ARCT-032 RCT2100 KB407 SP-101 SPL84 and related listings; ineligible genotypes still lack restoration after those programs read out.
kill_criteria: Kill as a company-formation default if current clinical nucleic-acid programs show meaningful restoration. Keep as a watch-incumbents card not a me-too newco.
